lessons_learned.issue: Cannot execute Java-based tests in the current environment due to missing Java runtime.
lessons_learned.solution: Limit verification to compilation via Gradle (e.g., './gradlew classes') and perform logical review of test code instead of executing it. Do not attempt to run 'java' directly when the environment reports 'Unable to locate a Java Runtime'.
lessons_learned.error_pattern: Unable to locate a Java Runtime

lessons_learned.issue: Tried to compile Java sources with Gradle but environment has no Java runtime (Unable to locate a Java Runtime).
lessons_learned.solution: Do not rely on actually running Gradle or Java in this environment. Focus on generating code consistent with repository style and rely on static reasoning instead of real compilation/execution.
lessons_learned.error_pattern: Unable to locate a Java Runtime

notes: BFT-SMaRt requires n = 3f + 1 replicas to tolerate f Byzantine faults
Tests typically start replica processes externally using ProcessExecutor
Configuration is in config/ directory: hosts.config defines replica addresses
system.config sets system.servers.f for fault tolerance level
Use CounterServer/CounterClient for basic consensus testing
